# Data Migration Checklist: Normalized Catalog & Per-Service Pools

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the catalog migration, cutover, rollback, and retention requirements before planning.
**Created**: 2026-10-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the migration's source and destination data shapes described at the requirement level, including what moves, what is derived, and what is discarded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the complete set of data the migration must preserve enumerated across catalog and user data? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are availability attributes — service, region, monetization type, link, and observation time — explicitly required through migration? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, §FR-019, §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for titles with no availability entries during and after migration? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are migration-run observability requirements defined, including counts, failures, and the point from which a rerun resumes? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are rollback triggers and decision criteria defined, not only the mechanism that switches the source? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "no data loss" quantified with specific, verifiable criteria for catalog and user data? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is "idempotent and resumable" defined in observable terms, including rerun behavior, duplicate prevention, and resume point? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is parity defined precisely enough to test: same catalog version, same quiz answers, same eligible set, same order? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "complete catalog version" precise enough to decide when promotion may occur? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "last successful observation" defined for both availability entries and titles with no availability? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the runtime switch's observable behavior defined for both directions and for reads already in flight? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §SC-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 - Is the sequencing of parity and per-service enrichment explicit and consistent across the requirements and assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are per-slice failure isolation and mixed-version promotion consistent about what readers see? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §FR-014, §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK015 - Do the rollback, snapshot-refresh, and retention requirements agree about how long the fallback remains usable? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-015, §FR-029, §SC-014]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the "existing clients unchanged" requirement consistent with the new optional deck filters and watchlist id lookup? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-027, §FR-028, §SC-012, §SC-013]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is it clear whether the snapshot and the normalized catalog coexist during parity and which one is authoritative? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008, §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 - Is the parity matrix's composition (at least 100 combinations) defined enough to be reproducible by a reviewer? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are verification counts and tolerances specified for migrated titles and availability entries? [Measurability, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are the user-data sample size and success threshold specified for post-migration verification? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are rollback's time bound and success condition objectively measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is the retention purge's success condition measurable for both catalog deletion and user-data survival? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for an interrupted, restarted, or repeated migration, including resume and duplicate prevention? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for a malformed or missing source snapshot? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are requirements defined for cutover or rollback while a refresh is running? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are requirements defined for a title referenced by user data but absent from both the snapshot and the new catalog? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are requirements defined for migrating while visitors read the catalog? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, §Assumptions]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK028 - Is the behavior defined when the source snapshot is older than the retention limit? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 - Is the behavior defined when a title has user data but no availability entries? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-016, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are rollback requirements defined for the period after per-service enrichment is live? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is the behavior defined when availability changes between the migrated snapshot and the first completed refresh? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the behavior defined when the same title arrives from multiple source lists during import? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK033 - Is the online-migration constraint — no maintenance window — stated as a testable requirement? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are migration duration or resource bounds specified, or explicitly deferred with a rationale? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are credential-safety requirements explicit for migration and refresh, including logs and responses? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, §SC-009]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK036 - Is the stable-title-identifier assumption validated against the data the migration will read? [Assumption, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK037 - Is the assumption that the existing per-region snapshot is a complete migration source documented and checked? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK038 - Is the dependency on the provider's rate limits and retention terms documented for the migration and refresh? [Dependency, Spec §FR-015, §Assumptions, §SC-010]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK039 - Does "data loss" have one consistent meaning across catalog data and user data? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK040 - Is the meaning of "existing snapshot" defined per region, including behavior if more than one snapshot exists? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
